Vision Research Foundation Pledges to meet the patients’ requirements by offering expert ophthalmic care with compassion through a dedicated and committed team of well qualified and trained professionals. Bronze Certified 2023 FCRA 80G 12A Transparency Rating: Transparency Rating The transparency rating is calculated based on the amount of information available for the organisation. Geographies Served Programs Ocular Pathology District Chennai State Tamil Nadu District Chennai States Tamil Nadu The department specializes in diagnosing ophthalmic conditions, including ocular surface, lid, and intraocular tumors. Additionally, our pathologists possess extensive experience in diagnosing various disorders through skin biopsy. Our primary research emphasis is on elucidating the molecular mechanisms underlying ocular tumors and identifying biomarkers. Furthermore, we are dedicated to advancing our understanding of the immunological aspects of eye diseases. With numerous awards and international recognition, our departmental members have contributed to over 500 publications in the field. Bioinformatics District Chennai State Tamil Nadu District Chennai States Tamil Nadu The Centre for Bioinformatics is dedicated to advancing our understanding of biological processes relevant to Vision Research. Our key objectives include: Establishing leadership in utilizing modern bioinformatics tools for investigating and treating ocular diseases, with the aim of becoming a focal point for ophthalmic researchers across India. Developing expertise, analytical tools, and methodologies for handling vast amounts of biomedical data from genomic, transcriptomic, proteomic, and metabolomic studies. We leverage high-performance computational systems to discern differences between healthy and diseased states. Offering personalized training to enhance the bioinformatics skills of ophthalmic investigators, empowering them to apply these tools effectively in their research. Organizing workshops, training programs, and seminars to educate ophthalmic researchers and those in other biological disciplines about the diverse applications of bioinformatics in modern biology. Milestones & Track Record VRF has established the Kamalnayan Bajaj Institute for Research in Vision and Ophthalmology in 2008, a 40,000 sq.feet 7-storied building dedicated to comprehensive vision research. --> --> Leadership Team Dr Ronnie Jacob George Director Research Dr S Sripriya Research Head - Department of Genetics Dr Krishnakumar Subramanian Research Head - Department of Ocular Pathology, Nano Biotechnology, Stem cell Biology Dr A R Anand Research Head - Department of Microbiology Dr Sharada Ramsubramanyan Research Head - Department of Biochemistry & Cell Biology Dr Srujana Chitipothu Research Head - Department of Bioinformatics & Central Research Instrumentation Facility Demographics & Structure Organisation Strength None M&E Internal, External Assessors No --> Political & Religious Declarations On Affiliation if any No On Deployment Bias if any No --> Registration Details PAN Card AAATV2725M Registration Number 117 of 1983 CSR Form 1 Not Available VO ID / Darpan ID TN/2016/0107788 --> 80G AAATV2725MF20214 12A AAATV2725ME20214 FCRA 075900266 About Headquarters Chennai, Tamil Nadu Since 1985 Demographies Served Youth Women Children Men Adolescents --> Impact VRF has trained about 60 PhDs in its research laboratories to date, with an average of 3 research scientists earning a Doctorate every year in their chosen area of research. Vision and Mission The mission of the Vision Research Foundation is to reduce retinal blindness worldwide by funding programs in research and education.
